data.one_liner: Convert integers or strings to Arabic numeral representation
data.what_it_does: The package exposes an ArabicNumbers class that can convert an int or string into its Arabic numeral string. It returns the Arabic digit string for the given value.
use_when: You need to display numbers in Arabic script in a Flutter app
You want a quick, dependency‑free way to convert numeric values to Arabic digits
avoid_when: You need full locale‑aware number formatting or other internationalization features
strengths: Null‑safe, works on all supported platforms
weaknesses: Only handles numeric conversion, no formatting options
No support for locale‑specific formatting or other numeral systems
